why: useSuspenseQueries/useQueries combine is no longer called while queries would suspend, so side effects or assumptions in combine change.
Unsubscribed queries no longer report an optimistic fetching state, changing returned status values.
Prefetch hooks now go through queryClient.query/infiniteQuery, which may change prefetch behavior.
Types-only revert of NoInfer on useQuery return types.
Type fix so select callback gets proper generics, matching intended typing.
Fixes declaration emit errors for exported inferred options.
Default TData generic changed to InfiniteData<TQueryFnData>, which can cause type errors for code relying on the old default.
Type fix allowing omitted variables when undefined is accepted, which accepts all previous code.
The promise property on query results and render-time prefetching are removed, so code using them fails.
Build output change avoiding runtime import of type-only exports; no observable API change.
Same optimistic fetching bug fix for useQueries; the docs expect no fetching state when unsubscribed.
Hooks experimental_beforeQuery and experimental_afterQuery were removed; they were unused so passing them is likely ignored.
placeholderData is removed from suspense infinite query options, so passing it now gives a type error.
Falsy errors now reach the error boundary as expected; bug fix.
Codemods packaging cleanup with no user-observable behavior.
Build tooling change to Vite 8 with no described user-facing change.
